# v0.18.19 direct local Relay pixel path

The private Relay path may consume immutable native RGB captures directly.
This optimizes representation and capture lifetime only. Mission source,
visual-2 calibration, thresholds, target regions and revisions 9/OFF and 11/ON
remain exact. A profile time or keyboard guess never creates Relay authority.
Do not silently enable OFF or rewrite a frozen batch when changing engines.

Raw frames bind owned RGB bytes, size, capture-start monotonic time, HWND and
exact bounds. Their domain-separated raw-rgb-v1 digest is not a PNG digest;
tag ledger/journal hashes with their encoding. Never pass mutable PIL images
or a caller-created frame through MCP as input authority. Human evidence may
serialize an exact PNG for its durable pause; the click decision uses raw data.

Keep stable candidate/preflight evidence, durable intent, a separate final
fresh dispatch witness, once-only never-replay state, Stop/Pause/Human,
Controller/Plan, foreground/geometry and watchdog/input-mutex ordering.
The 0.5-second witness limit starts before native capture and is unchanged.
Legacy PNG pending/committed ledgers remain consumed after restore.

Own persistent MSS resources on the monitor thread and close them there in
finally. A present raw adapter that fails is a typed input block, never blind
input or silent stale-frame fallback. The PNG adapter remains for backends
without raw capture; current Windows Relay prefers raw. Public stage samples
remain PNG and negative raw scans do not publish new observation authority.

# Axiom Vision v0.18.19 — Relay Direct

เปลี่ยนเส้นกด Cookie Relay เป็นตัวตอบสนองในเครื่องที่อ่านพิกเซลจากหน้าจอโดยตรง
ไม่สร้าง PNG แล้วถอดภาพซ้ำในช่วงตัดสินใจกด ไม่รอ Codex หรือ OCR ทั้งภาพ

- ใช้ MSS capture context เดิมตลอดช่วงเฝ้า และคืนทรัพยากรบน thread เจ้าของเมื่อจบ
- เก็บ RGB เป็นข้อมูลที่เปลี่ยนไม่ได้ พร้อมเวลาเริ่มจับภาพ HWND และ Geometry
- ใช้ตัวตรวจ Relay visual-2 และ Human Verification เดิมกับพิกเซลโดยตรง
- ตรวจความสดเฉพาะปุ่มจาก RGB โดยใช้วิธีและเกณฑ์เดิม
- ยังคงภาพเสถียรก่อน intent และภาพสดอีกชุดก่อนส่งคลิก
  อายุภาพเริ่มนับก่อนจับภาพและต้องไม่เกิน 0.5 วินาที
- เก็บชนิดข้อมูลและ hash ให้ชัดว่าเป็น raw RGB หรือ PNG และไม่กดซ้ำหลังผลไม่แน่ชัด

เกณฑ์ภาพ ขอบเขตปุ่ม สิทธิ์ input และ Plan ไม่เปลี่ยนจาก v0.18.18
Relay OFF ใช้ revision 9; Relay ON ใช้ revision 11 ตามเดิม
แบตช์ Relay revision 10 ที่เก่ากว่ายังต้อง Stop และ Reset ตามกฎเดิม
การอัปเดตไม่เปลี่ยนแบตช์ OFF ให้เป็น ON และไม่แก้แผนที่กำลังรัน

วิธีเปิดใช้งาน

1. ถ้าแบตช์ปัจจุบันเป็น Relay OFF ให้ Stop รอ worker หยุด แล้ว Reset Batch
2. อัปเดตที่ Settings → CHECK UPDATE และเปิด Controller ใหม่หลังติดตั้ง
3. เลือก Short / Normal / Custom หรือ Preset เวลา แล้วเลือก COOKIE RELAY → ON
4. ตรวจข้อความ Relay: On ในแผนก่อนกด START BATCH

AUTO ยังใช้ Relay ไม่ได้ Preset บันทึกเฉพาะเวลา ไม่เปิด Relay ให้อัตโนมัติ
Preset และประวัติเดิมยังอยู่ ข้อความหน้า UI แยก OFF และ ON ให้ชัดขึ้น

Log วันที่ 25 ตุลาคมที่ผู้ใช้ส่งเป็น Relay OFF จึงไม่มีข้อมูล latency ของ Relay ที่เปิดใช้งาน
การทดสอบรุ่นนี้เทียบกับโค้ด v0.18.18 และภาพต้นฉบับ พร้อมเส้นตรวจจริงในเครื่องทดสอบ
ยังไม่ได้ยืนยัน native screen grab, การรับคลิก หรือเวลาจริงบน Windows/LDPlayer ของผู้ใช้

"""Direct RGB Relay transactions exercise the actual guards and durable files."""
from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
import threading
import time
from types import SimpleNamespace
import unittest
from unittest import mock

from PIL import Image

import test_cookie_relay_hot_path as hot
from visionstudio_cookie_relay_frame import RawRelayFrame

bridge = hot.bridge


class CookieRelayDirectPathTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def fixture(self, directory):
        server, session, desktop, window, png = hot.CookieRelayHotPathTests.real_fixture(self, Path(directory))
        with Image.open(io.BytesIO(png)) as source:
            rgb = source.convert("RGB").tobytes()
        frames = []

        def capture(_window):
            frame = RawRelayFrame.from_rgb((window.width, window.height), rgb,
                captured_at=time.monotonic(), hwnd=window.hwnd,
                bounds=(window.left, window.top, window.width, window.height))
            frames.append(frame)
            return frame

        desktop.capture_relay_frame = capture
        desktop.capture_png = mock.Mock(side_effect=AssertionError("Relay entered PNG capture"))
        return server, session, desktop, window, frames, capture

    def test_direct_transaction_uses_no_png_codec_and_keeps_exact_input_guards(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            server, session, desktop, window, frames, _capture = self.fixture(temporary)
            ordinary = copy.deepcopy((session.last_image, session.observations,
                session.stage_action_attempts, session.committed_stage_ids, session.completed_stage_ids))
            native = desktop.click

            def click(*args):
                ledger = json.loads(session.checkpoint_path.read_bytes())["cookie_relay_state"]
                self.assertEqual((ledger["status"], ledger["replay"]), ("pending", "never"))
                self.assertEqual(ledger["frame_encoding"], "raw-rgb-v1")
                return native(*args)

            desktop.click = click
            with mock.patch("PIL.Image.open", side_effect=AssertionError("Relay decoded PNG")):
                server._capture_cookie_relay_sample(session)
            self.assertEqual(len(desktop.clicks), 1)
            self.assertEqual(len(frames), 4)  # Initial, stable, dispatch, post.
            self.assertEqual(session.cookie_relay_state["status"], "committed")
            self.assertEqual(session.cookie_relay_state["dispatch_frame_encoding"], "raw-rgb-v1")
            self.assertEqual(session.cookie_relay_state["post_frame_encoding"], "raw-rgb-v1")
            self.assertEqual(ordinary, (session.last_image, session.observations,
                session.stage_action_attempts, session.committed_stage_ids, session.completed_stage_ids))
            desktop.capture_png.assert_not_called()

    def test_invalid_raw_capture_cannot_fall_back_to_png_or_prepare_intent(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            server, session, desktop, window, _frames, _capture = self.fixture(temporary)
            desktop.capture_relay_frame = lambda _window: b"not a raw frame"
            with self.assertRaises(bridge.BridgeError):
                server._capture_cookie_relay_sample(session)
            self.assertFalse(desktop.clicks)
            self.assertEqual(session.cookie_relay_state["status"], "ready")
            desktop.capture_png.assert_not_called()

    def test_wrong_raw_hwnd_or_geometry_cannot_prepare_intent(self):
        for field in ("hwnd", "bounds"):
            with self.subTest(field=field), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
                server, session, desktop, window, _frames, capture = self.fixture(temporary)
                original = capture(window)
                bounds = original.bounds if field == "hwnd" else (window.left+1, window.top, window.width, window.height)
                desktop.capture_relay_frame = lambda _window: RawRelayFrame.from_rgb(original.size, original.rgb,
                    captured_at=time.monotonic(), hwnd=window.hwnd+1 if field == "hwnd" else window.hwnd,
                    bounds=bounds)
                with self.assertRaises(bridge.BridgeError):
                    server._capture_cookie_relay_sample(session)
                self.assertFalse(desktop.clicks)
                self.assertEqual(session.cookie_relay_state["attempts"], 0)

    def test_raw_capture_failure_after_intent_preserves_pending_never_replay(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            server, session, desktop, window, _frames, capture = self.fixture(temporary)
            calls = [0]

            def fail_dispatch(_window):
                calls[0] += 1
                if calls[0] == 3:
                    raise RuntimeError("native raw capture unavailable")
                return capture(_window)

            desktop.capture_relay_frame = fail_dispatch
            with self.assertRaises(bridge.BridgeError):
                server._capture_cookie_relay_sample(session)
            self.assertFalse(desktop.clicks)
            self.assertEqual(session.cookie_relay_state["status"], "pending")
            self.assertEqual(session.cookie_relay_state["attempts"], 1)
            self.assertEqual(session.cookie_relay_state["replay"], "never")

    def test_human_raw_frame_is_encoded_only_for_exact_pause_evidence(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            server, session, desktop, window, _frames, capture = self.fixture(temporary)
            frame = capture(window)
            server._latch_human_verification = mock.Mock(return_value={})
            detected = {"matched": True, "distance": 0.0, "detector": "known-card-verification-signature-v1"}
            with mock.patch.object(bridge, "_detect_human_verification_image", return_value=detected):
                self.assertTrue(server._cookie_relay_human_guard(session, window, frame))
            forwarded = server._latch_human_verification.call_args.kwargs["_cookie_relay_frame"]
            self.assertTrue(forwarded.startswith(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"))
            with Image.open(io.BytesIO(forwarded)) as exact:
                self.assertEqual(exact.convert("RGB").tobytes(), frame.rgb)
            self.assertFalse(desktop.clicks)

    def test_native_mss_context_is_reused_and_closed_on_its_owner_thread(self):
        desktop = object.__new__(bridge.WindowsDesktop)
        window = SimpleNamespace(left=3, top=5, width=640, height=360, hwnd=77)
        image = Image.new("RGB", (640, 360), (30, 90, 50))
        capture = mock.Mock()
        capture.grab.return_value = SimpleNamespace(size=image.size, bgra=image.tobytes("raw", "BGRX"))
        module = SimpleNamespace(mss=mock.Mock(return_value=capture))
        with mock.patch.dict("sys.modules", {"mss": module}):
            first = desktop.capture_relay_frame(window)
            second = desktop.capture_relay_frame(window)
            desktop.close_relay_capture()
            desktop.close_relay_capture()
        self.assertEqual(module.mss.call_count, 1)
        self.assertEqual(capture.grab.call_count, 2)
        capture.close.assert_called_once()
        self.assertEqual(first.rgb, image.tobytes())
        self.assertEqual(second.bounds, (3, 5, 640, 360))

    def test_expired_raw_preflight_and_dispatch_still_check_their_human_pixels(self):
        for expired_capture, expected_attempts in ((2, 0), (3, 1)):
            with self.subTest(expired_capture=expired_capture), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
                server, session, desktop, window, _frames, capture = self.fixture(temporary)
                calls = [0]
                human = mock.Mock(wraps=server._cookie_relay_human_guard)
                server._cookie_relay_human_guard = human

                def slow_frame(_window):
                    calls[0] += 1
                    frame = capture(_window)
                    if calls[0] == expired_capture:
                        return RawRelayFrame.from_rgb(frame.size, frame.rgb,
                            captured_at=time.monotonic()-1, hwnd=frame.hwnd, bounds=frame.bounds)
                    return frame

                desktop.capture_relay_frame = slow_frame
                server._capture_cookie_relay_sample(session)
                self.assertEqual(human.call_count, expired_capture)
                self.assertFalse(desktop.clicks)
                self.assertEqual(session.cookie_relay_state["attempts"], expected_attempts)
                self.assertEqual(session.cookie_relay_state["status"], "pending" if expected_attempts else "ready")

    def test_raw_dispatch_obeys_stop_and_pause_after_the_last_window_check(self):
        for desired in ("stopped", "paused"):
            with self.subTest(desired=desired), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
                server, session, desktop, window, _frames, _capture = self.fixture(temporary)
                verified = server._verified_action_window
                checks = [0]

                def boundary(_session):
                    result = verified(_session)
                    checks[0] += 1
                    if checks[0] == 3:
                        bridge.controller_module.patch_state(session.controller_state_path, desired_state=desired)
                    return result

                server._verified_action_window = boundary
                with self.assertRaises(bridge.BridgeError):
                    server._capture_cookie_relay_sample(session)
                self.assertEqual(checks[0], 3)
                self.assertFalse(desktop.clicks)
                self.assertEqual(session.cookie_relay_state["status"], "pending")
                self.assertEqual(session.cookie_relay_state["attempts"], 1)

    def test_monitor_finally_closes_raw_capture_after_capture_failure(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            server, session, desktop, _window, _frames, _capture = self.fixture(temporary)
            desktop.capture_relay_frame = mock.Mock(side_effect=RuntimeError("MSS failed"))
            desktop.close_relay_capture = mock.Mock()
            session.running_monitor_started_monotonic = time.monotonic()
            session.running_monitor_focus_seconds = 5
            session.running_monitor_state = "running"
            server._running_monitor_worker(session, session.running_monitor_stop)
            desktop.close_relay_capture.assert_called_once()
            self.assertEqual(session.running_monitor_state, "error")
            self.assertFalse(desktop.clicks)
            self.assertEqual(session.cookie_relay_state["attempts"], 0)

    def test_black_raw_sample_still_runs_one_human_check(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            server, session, desktop, window, _frames, _capture = self.fixture(temporary)
            desktop.capture_relay_frame = lambda _window: RawRelayFrame.from_rgb((window.width, window.height),
                bytes(window.width*window.height*3), captured_at=time.monotonic(), hwnd=window.hwnd,
                bounds=(window.left, window.top, window.width, window.height))
            human = mock.Mock(wraps=server._cookie_relay_human_guard)
            server._cookie_relay_human_guard = human
            server._capture_cookie_relay_sample(session)
            human.assert_called_once()
            self.assertFalse(desktop.clicks)
            self.assertEqual(session.cookie_relay_state["attempts"], 0)

    def test_main_thread_cannot_close_the_monitor_threads_native_context(self):
        desktop = object.__new__(bridge.WindowsDesktop)
        desktop._relay_capture_local = threading.local()
        window = SimpleNamespace(left=3, top=5, width=640, height=360, hwnd=77)
        image = Image.new("RGB", (640, 360), (30, 90, 50))
        capture = mock.Mock()
        capture.grab.return_value = SimpleNamespace(size=image.size, bgra=image.tobytes("raw", "BGRX"))
        ready, finish = threading.Event(), threading.Event()
        owners = []
        capture.close.side_effect = lambda: owners.append(threading.get_ident())
        module = SimpleNamespace(mss=mock.Mock(return_value=capture))

        def worker():
            desktop.capture_relay_frame(window)
            ready.set()
            finish.wait(3)
            desktop.close_relay_capture()

        with mock.patch.dict("sys.modules", {"mss": module}):
            thread = threading.Thread(target=worker)
            thread.start()
            self.assertTrue(ready.wait(3))
            desktop.close_relay_capture()
            capture.close.assert_not_called()
            finish.set()
            thread.join(3)
        self.assertFalse(thread.is_alive())
        self.assertEqual(owners, [thread.ident])

    def test_legacy_png_pending_or_committed_ledger_cannot_replay_through_raw_capture(self):
        for status in ("pending", "committed"):
            with self.subTest(status=status), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
                server, session, desktop, window, png = hot.CookieRelayHotPathTests.real_fixture(self, Path(temporary))
                if status == "pending":
                    detect = server._detect_cookie_relay
                    calls = [0]

                    def disappear(image):
                        calls[0] += 1
                        return None if calls[0] == 3 else detect(image)

                    server._detect_cookie_relay = disappear
                server._capture_cookie_relay_sample(session)
                checkpoint = session.checkpoint_payload()
                legacy = checkpoint["cookie_relay_state"]
                self.assertEqual(legacy["status"], status)
                self.assertEqual(legacy["before_frame_sha256"], bridge.sha256_bytes(png))
                for key in ("frame_encoding", "dispatch_frame_encoding", "post_frame_encoding"):
                    legacy.pop(key, None)
                before = copy.deepcopy(legacy)
                restored = bridge.BridgeSession(session.mission_path, session.mission,
                    Path(temporary) / "restore.jsonl", mission_contract_sha256=session.mission_contract_sha256,
                    mission_source="universal-code", universal_config=session.universal_config)
                restored.data_root = Path(temporary)
                self.assertTrue(restored.restore_checkpoint(checkpoint))
                restored.resume_required = restored.resume_confirmation_pending = restored.checkpoint_recovery_pending = False
                restored.running_monitor_active = True
                restored.running_monitor_thread = threading.current_thread()
                restored.running_monitor_stage_id, restored.running_monitor_stage_phase = "passive-running", "entered"
                restored.fixed_geometry_bounds = session.fixed_geometry_bounds
                restored._cookie_relay_controller_batch_id = session._cookie_relay_controller_batch_id
                restored.last_window, restored.last_image = window, png
                server.session = restored
                if status == "pending":
                    delattr(server, "_detect_cookie_relay")
                with Image.open(io.BytesIO(png)) as source:
                    rgb = source.convert("RGB").tobytes()
                captured = []

                def raw(_window):
                    captured.append(True)
                    return RawRelayFrame.from_rgb((window.width, window.height), rgb,
                        captured_at=time.monotonic(), hwnd=window.hwnd, bounds=restored.fixed_geometry_bounds)

                desktop.capture_relay_frame = raw
                desktop.capture_png = mock.Mock(side_effect=AssertionError("Legacy relay re-entered PNG path"))
                desktop.clicks.clear()
                server._capture_cookie_relay_sample(restored)
                self.assertEqual(len(captured), 1)
                self.assertFalse(desktop.clicks)
                self.assertEqual(restored.cookie_relay_state, before)

"""Immutable native pixels and exact PNG/raw guard equivalence."""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import FrozenInstanceError
import hashlib
import io
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import unittest
from unittest import mock

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))

import visionstudio_bridge as bridge
from visionstudio_cookie_relay import detect_cookie_relay, detect_cookie_relay_frame
from visionstudio_cookie_relay_frame import (
    FRAME_FORMAT, RawRelayFrame, compare_raw_relay_freshness, frame_is_near_black,
)
from visionstudio_cookie_relay_freshness import compare_cookie_relay_freshness
from test_cookie_relay_vision import relay_frame


def png(image):
    output = io.BytesIO()
    image.save(output, "PNG", compress_level=1)
    return output.getvalue()


def raw(image, *, captured_at=1000.0, hwnd=17, left=40, top=30):
    return RawRelayFrame.from_image(
        image, captured_at=captured_at, hwnd=hwnd,
        bounds=(left, top, image.width, image.height),
    )


class CookieRelayFrameTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_mss_bgrx_channels_are_rgb_and_alpha_is_unused(self):
        pixels = bytearray((3, 2, 1, 0, 13, 12, 11, 255))
        first = RawRelayFrame.from_bgra((2, 1), pixels, captured_at=1, hwnd=17, bounds=(-2, 3, 2, 1))
        self.assertEqual(first.rgb, bytes((1, 2, 3, 11, 12, 13)))
        self.assertEqual(first.image().getpixel((1, 0)), (11, 12, 13))
        before = first.frame_sha256
        pixels[:] = bytes(len(pixels))
        self.assertEqual(first.frame_sha256, before)
        self.assertEqual(first.rgb, bytes((1, 2, 3, 11, 12, 13)))
        self.assertEqual(first.encoding, FRAME_FORMAT)
        self.assertEqual(first.capture_size, (2, 1))

    def test_pixel_storage_and_image_copies_cannot_mutate_a_frame(self):
        image = Image.new("RGB", (2, 2), (10, 20, 30))
        frame = raw(image)
        image.putpixel((0, 0), (255, 0, 0))
        copy = frame.image()
        copy.putpixel((0, 0), (0, 255, 0))
        self.assertEqual(frame.image().getpixel((0, 0)), (10, 20, 30))
        with self.assertRaises(FrozenInstanceError):
            frame.rgb = bytes(12)
        self.assertNotIn(str(frame.rgb), repr(frame))

    def test_digest_binds_dimensions_and_pixels_with_a_separate_encoding_domain(self):
        pixels = bytes(range(18))
        a = RawRelayFrame.from_rgb((2, 3), pixels, captured_at=1, hwnd=1, bounds=(0, 0, 2, 3))
        b = RawRelayFrame.from_rgb((3, 2), pixels, captured_at=1, hwnd=1, bounds=(0, 0, 3, 2))
        c = RawRelayFrame.from_rgb((2, 3), pixels, captured_at=2, hwnd=2, bounds=(3, -4, 2, 3))
        self.assertNotEqual(a.frame_sha256, b.frame_sha256)
        self.assertEqual(a.frame_sha256, c.frame_sha256)
        self.assertNotEqual(a.frame_sha256, hashlib.sha256(a.to_png()).hexdigest())

    def test_invalid_native_buffer_and_window_metadata_are_rejected(self):
        for size in ((0, 1), (1, -1), (True, 1), (4001, 4001), [1, 1]):
            with self.subTest(size=size), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                RawRelayFrame.from_bgra(size, bytes(4), captured_at=1, hwnd=1, bounds=(0, 0, 1, 1))
        for buffer in (bytes(3), bytes(5), "1234", None):
            with self.subTest(buffer=buffer), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                RawRelayFrame.from_bgra((1, 1), buffer, captured_at=1, hwnd=1, bounds=(0, 0, 1, 1))
        for timestamp in (True, -1, float("nan"), float("inf"), "1"):
            with self.subTest(timestamp=timestamp), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                RawRelayFrame((1, 1), bytes(3), timestamp, 1, (0, 0, 1, 1))
        for hwnd in (False, 0, -1, "17"):
            with self.subTest(hwnd=hwnd), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                RawRelayFrame((1, 1), bytes(3), 1, hwnd, (0, 0, 1, 1))
        for bounds in ((0, 0, 2, 1), (0, 0, True, 1), (0, 0, 1), [0, 0, 1, 1]):
            with self.subTest(bounds=bounds), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                RawRelayFrame((1, 1), bytes(3), 1, 1, bounds)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            RawRelayFrame((1, 1), bytearray(3), 1, 1, (0, 0, 1, 1))

    def test_png_compatibility_adapter_preserves_pixels_and_evidence_roundtrip(self):
        image = relay_frame().resize((1600, 900), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
        first = raw(image)
        second = RawRelayFrame.from_png(png(image), captured_at=1001, hwnd=17, bounds=first.bounds)
        self.assertEqual(first.rgb, second.rgb)
        self.assertEqual(first.frame_sha256, second.frame_sha256)
        with Image.open(io.BytesIO(first.to_png())) as saved:
            self.assertEqual(saved.convert("RGB").tobytes(), first.rgb)
        for payload in (b"", b"not-png", bytearray(b"not-png")):
            with self.subTest(payload=payload), self.assertRaises((OSError, ValueError)):
                RawRelayFrame.from_png(payload, captured_at=1, hwnd=17, bounds=(0, 0, 2, 2))

    def test_black_guard_matches_png_guard_for_dark_and_nonblack_scenes(self):
        for color in ((0, 0, 0), (12, 12, 12), (13, 13, 13), (10, 50, 10), (255, 255, 255)):
            image = Image.new("RGB", (640, 360), color)
            self.assertEqual(
                frame_is_near_black(raw(image), level=bridge.CAPTURE_NEAR_BLACK_LEVEL,
                                    ratio=bridge.CAPTURE_NEAR_BLACK_RATIO),
                bridge.image_is_near_black(png(image)),
            )

    def test_raw_roi_metrics_match_existing_png_metrics_on_animated_background(self):
        first = relay_frame().resize((1600, 900), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
        second = first.copy()
        ImageDraw.Draw(second).rectangle((0, 0, 600, 250), fill=(200, 0, 180))
        region = (710, 320, 230, 230)
        for changed_control in (False, True):
            if changed_control:
                ImageDraw.Draw(second).rectangle((730, 340, 850, 460), fill=(255, 0, 0))
            expected = compare_cookie_relay_freshness(
                png(first), png(second), region,
                thumbnail_size=bridge.FRESHNESS_THUMBNAIL_SIZE,
                pixel_delta=bridge.FRESHNESS_PIXEL_DELTA,
            )
            actual = compare_raw_relay_freshness(
                raw(first), raw(second), region,
                thumbnail_size=bridge.FRESHNESS_THUMBNAIL_SIZE,
                pixel_delta=bridge.FRESHNESS_PIXEL_DELTA,
            )
            for key in ("dimensions_match", "region_mean_delta", "region_changed_ratio"):
                self.assertEqual(actual[key], expected[key])

    def test_raw_roi_rejects_dimensions_and_invalid_target_regions(self):
        a = raw(Image.new("RGB", (20, 10), "red"))
        b = raw(Image.new("RGB", (20, 11), "red"))
        options = {"thumbnail_size": (96, 96), "pixel_delta": 24}
        self.assertFalse(compare_raw_relay_freshness(a, b, (0, 0, 10, 10), **options)["dimensions_match"])
        for region in ((-1, 0, 1, 1), (0, 0, 0, 1), (0, 0, 21, 1), (0, 0, 1, 11), (0, 0, True, 1), [0, 0, 1, 1]):
            result = compare_raw_relay_freshness(a, a, region, **options)
            self.assertIsNone(result["region_mean_delta"])

    def test_raw_hot_helpers_never_encode_or_decode_png(self):
        image = relay_frame().resize((1600, 900), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
        bgra = image.tobytes("raw", "BGRX")
        with mock.patch.object(Image, "open", side_effect=AssertionError("PNG decode in raw path")), \
             mock.patch.object(Image.Image, "save", side_effect=AssertionError("PNG encode in raw path")):
            frame = RawRelayFrame.from_bgra(image.size, bgra, captured_at=1, hwnd=17, bounds=(0, 0, *image.size))
            self.assertFalse(frame_is_near_black(frame, level=12, ratio=.999))
            proof = detect_cookie_relay_frame(frame)
            self.assertIsNotNone(proof)
            metrics = compare_raw_relay_freshness(frame, frame, proof.target_bounds,
                                                 thumbnail_size=(96, 96), pixel_delta=24)
            self.assertEqual(metrics["region_mean_delta"], 0)

    def test_png_and_raw_detection_keep_exact_semantic_proof_and_reject_missing_cues(self):
        image = relay_frame().resize((1600, 900), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
        for missing in (None, "prompt", "card", "jump", "slide"):
            part = image.copy()
            boxes = {"prompt": (470, 270, 1150, 320), "card": (710, 325, 925, 540),
                     "jump": (20, 710, 350, 895), "slide": (1280, 710, 1599, 895)}
            if missing:
                ImageDraw.Draw(part).rectangle(boxes[missing], fill=(20, 20, 20))
            encoded = png(part)
            native = raw(part)
            png_proof, raw_proof = detect_cookie_relay(encoded), detect_cookie_relay_frame(native)
            self.assertEqual(png_proof is None, raw_proof is None)
            self.assertEqual(png_proof is None, missing is not None)
            if png_proof:
                self.assertEqual((png_proof.capture_size, png_proof.target_bounds, png_proof.center,
                                  png_proof.confidence, png_proof.detector_version),
                                 (raw_proof.capture_size, raw_proof.target_bounds, raw_proof.center,
                                  raw_proof.confidence, raw_proof.detector_version))
                self.assertEqual(png_proof.frame_sha256, hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest())
                self.assertEqual(raw_proof.frame_sha256, native.frame_sha256)
